definitions.correction: Current speaker replaces/retracts an interpretation or prior term; not merely mentioning somebody else corrected something.
definitions.current_affirm: Current affirmative response to an observed question/readback/request, including recipient/admin scope. It is not a financial authorization label.
definitions.current_withdraw: Current retraction/suspension of previously expressed permission or arrangement. First refusal without a prior grant is separate and is not this label.
definitions.dispute: Current speaker contests liability, ownership, amount or a claimed payment/account fact; may coexist with willingness to pay.
definitions.proposal: Current speaker makes or revises an own payment intention/commitment; completion/value resolution separate. Hypothetical and solely reported commitments are not own proposals.
definitions.reported_third_party: Speaker attributes relevant statements/intention to another person or institution rather than adopting all of them as own current intent.
definitions.uncertain: Conditional, hypothetical, tentative, incomplete or referentially ambiguous relevant content. Does not mechanically blank complete unrelated acts.

negative_negation: I am not asking you to stop is not a withdrawal; scoped no/not must not blank unrelated acts.
reported_scope: Third-party reports do not imply a current own promise or consent.
scope: semantic proposals only; affirmative includes admin/identity and never bank permission; model scores cannot authenticate input or authorize any bank write
unknown_mask: False means unlabelled for this head, NOT negative. Numeric/date/target resolution and authority heads remain UNKNOWN.
